question.author: member_008
question.body: I am setting up CloudBox and want to understand rate limits. What does the current documentation say?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current API Reference documentation says: API requests are limited to 1000 requests per hour per token. When the limit is hit, the API returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header; clients should implement exponential backoff. Burst allowances are not available. Read-only endpoints (listing, metadata) count the same as writes. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
